message: Hey John, it's been a while since we caught up on family stuff. How's everyone doing?

Can you believe Sarah finally graduated? University of Springfield's ceremony was decent, but her smile made it all worth it. Also, my cousin Emily had a moment with me after the ceremony; she shared that she is lesbian and was nervous about how the family might react. I reassured her that we love her no matter what.

Remember when Sarah was stressing about her thesis? Well, she nailed it and even got an award! And speaking of accomplishments, my cousin Emily gathered the courage to open up about her sexual orientation, which is a big step for her. She's feeling a lot more at ease now.
